title: 第二十二章 认输第二十三章 望月峰
content_zh:
这一战，秦凤鸣可谓手段尽展，心机尽出，对面那使抢青年虽然不是师傅所言那四名可以战胜自己之人，但却绝非庸手。
一番劳累，却是在所难免。
但让秦凤鸣困惑之处是，不管其有多劳累，只要其打坐片刻时间，其体力就会完全恢复过来。
但观察其他弟子，虽然打坐可以极快恢复体力，但所需时间，却比他要多花费数倍时间不止。
如此情形，让秦凤鸣也是困惑不已。
上午之时，胜者组与败者组，均以决出了前八。
午饭之后，败者组仅需决出前四即可。
而秦凤鸣此时所在的胜者组，就要一直争斗，决出第一名。
秦凤鸣此时手持的依旧是七号号牌，在一场比试之后，他再次登上了石台。
站立秦凤鸣面前的，此次是一名手持木棒青年，这青年面色稳重，双目之中，似有一威严存在其中，一望之下，秦凤鸣心中就是一惊。
仅看表面，就可知这青年是一难缠角色。
听主持比试青年介绍双方姓名，秦凤鸣才自知晓，对面之人，名为林永锋，骤闻此三字，秦凤鸣心中就是一惊，这名字，曾经听闻小师姐介绍过一番。
知道其一套伏虎棍法，神出鬼没以极。
能让秦凤鸣如此忌惮之人，却是因为，此林永峰，正是师傅曾经言说的那四名大有胜过自己之人中的一人。
目视面前青年，秦凤鸣心中也是不由禁惴惴不安起来。
但此过程仅一闪即逝，此次比试进入前十的任务已然完成，现在只需要放手一搏就好。
看着面前仅有十二三的少年，林永锋已然知晓其虽然年少，但有真材实料在身，故此之下，他并未有一丝看轻秦凤鸣之意。
虽然秦凤鸣并未在林永峰心中既定对手之列，但两日比试下来，其凭借仅仅十二三岁年纪，便在众多好手之中脱颖而出进入前八，其难缠程度自是可想而知。
目视秦凤鸣少许，林永峰心中已有定计，那就是，决不能将对手看做是普通少年，比试之中多加提防，只要全力以赴，才可立于不败之地。
随着主持比试青年示意之下，秦凤鸣自习武以来，最为艰难一战，也自开始。

双方刚一接触，却均是显得很是小心，虽均有攻守，但却相互试探居多，场面之上，更是缺少了上午之时的火爆场面。
秦凤鸣将飘柳十三式施展开，身形飘忽不定，进退极为规矩，剑随人转，只见一团白色匹练在高台之上滴溜溜乱转，一时无法看清其身形。
那林永锋也将长棍施展而开，伏虎棍法展现出一层层虚幻棍影，将其护在中央，其棍法之中却是三分攻，七分守，不求有功，但求无过。
二人在高台之上如同走马灯一般，斗得不亦乐乎。
这一打斗就是小半个时辰，双方虽未有狠命争胜之态，但层出不穷的精妙招数，却也让台下观战的众人纷纷高声喝彩不断。
虽然二人你来我往，相争不下，但谁也未能奈何得了对方。
一边争斗，秦凤鸣却也不断偷眼观瞧，只见对方棍法精妙无比，就是自己全力以赴，也实在不好说就能将对方战败，当初师傅所言，真是丝毫不差，对方却有战胜自己实力。
双方如此相持，时间一久，对秦凤鸣自是十分不利，但要其尽全力，短时获胜，却也难以如愿。
暗自琢磨之下，秦凤鸣不由决心打定，那就是主动认输了事。
此时胜负，对其来说，已然没有什么吸引之力。
双方又斗了五十多回合，秦凤鸣突然倒退飞出一丈开外。
content_en:
In this battle, Qin Fengming showed all his skills and scheming. Although the young man facing him was not one of the four people his master said could defeat him, he was by no means mediocre.
A lot of hard work is inevitable.
But what confuses Qin Fengming is that no matter how tired he is, as long as he meditates for a while, his physical strength will be fully restored.
But observing other disciples, although meditation can restore physical strength very quickly, the time required is several times longer than his.
Such a situation made Qin Fengming confused.
In the morning, the top eight were determined in both the winner's group and the loser's group.
After lunch, the loser group only needs to decide the top four.
The winner's group in which Qin Fengming is currently will have to fight to determine the first place.
Qin Fengming was still holding the No. 7 plate at this time. After a competition, he climbed onto the stone platform again.
Standing in front of Qin Fengming, this time was a young man holding a wooden stick. This young man had a steady face, and there seemed to be a majesty in his eyes. Qin Fengming was shocked at first glance.
Just by looking at the surface, you can tell that this young man is a difficult character.
After listening to the young man hosting the competition introduce the names of both parties, Qin Fengming knew that the person opposite was named Lin Yongfeng. When he heard these three words, Qin Fengming was shocked. This name had been introduced by his junior sister.
He knows his method of crouching with a tiger stick, which makes him appear as mysterious as a ghost.
The reason why Qin Fengming was so afraid of someone was because Lin Yongfeng was one of the four people the master once said were more capable than him.
Looking at the young man in front of him, Qin Fengming couldn't help but feel uneasy.
But this process only happened in a flash. The task of entering the top ten in this competition has been completed. Now it is just a matter of giving it a try.
Looking at the young man in front of him who was only twelve or thirteen years old, Lin Yongfeng already knew that although he was young, he had real talents, so he did not look down on Qin Fengming at all.
Although Qin Fengming was not among Lin Yongfeng's scheduled opponents, after two days of competition, he stood out from the crowd and entered the top eight due to his age of only twelve or thirteen years old. You can imagine how difficult he is to fight.
After watching Qin Fengming for a while, Lin Yongfeng had already made up his mind, that is, he must not regard his opponent as an ordinary boy. He should be more careful during the competition. Only by going all out can he be invincible.
Following the instructions of the young man presiding over the competition, Qin Fengming began his most difficult battle since he started practicing martial arts.
As soon as the two sides came into contact, they both seemed very cautious. Although they both had offense and defense, they mostly tested each other. The scene lacked the hot scene in the morning.
Qin Fengming performed the Thirteen Postures of the Floating Willow. His figure was erratic, and he advanced and retreated very regularly. His sword turned with the person, and he saw a ball of white horses spinning around on the high platform, and it was impossible to see his figure clearly for a while.
Then Lin Yongfeng also spread out his long stick. The Fuhu stick technique showed layers of illusory stick shadows, protecting it in the center. However, his stick technique was three-point attack and seven-point defense. It did not seek merit, but sought no faults.
The two of them were like revolving lanterns on the high platform, fighting endlessly.
The fight lasted for less than half an hour. Although the two sides were not fighting for victory, the endless ingenious moves made everyone in the audience cheer loudly.
Although the two of them went back and forth and couldn't compete with each other, neither one could win over the other.
While fighting, Qin Fengming kept stealing glances and saw that the opponent's stick skills were extremely exquisite. Even if he tried his best, it was hard to say that he could defeat the opponent. What the master said at the beginning was true, but the opponent had the strength to defeat him.
The two sides are in such a stalemate for a long time, which is very detrimental to Qin Fengming, but even if he tries his best to win in a short time, it will be difficult to achieve his wish.
After thinking about it secretly, Qin Fengming couldn't help but decide that he would take the initiative to admit defeat.
Win or lose at this time, for it, it no longer has any attraction.
The two sides fought for more than fifty rounds, and Qin Fengming suddenly fell back and flew ten feet away.
